legend: Round to oval nuclei are arranged in a palisading pattern embedded in a fibrillary matrix (Giemsa).

Loosely cohesive tissue fragment of spindle cells with round to oval nuclei, some with pointed tips, embedded in a fibrillary matrix. Some anisonucleosis and an intranuclear cytoplasmic pseudoinclusion are identified (Pap).

Tissue fragments appear highly cellular and the cytoarchitectural arrangement of the cells is fascicular, corresponding to histopathological areas of Antoni A. Spindle cells with oval to pointed nuclei are embedded in a fibrillary matrix. Nuclear membranes are smooth and regular, and the chromatin texture is fine (Pap).
